title: Leadership Program
description: Leadership is not just a concept to be understood. It's a practice to be lived — in the body, in relationship, and over time. This multi-month program brings together a cohort of leaders in a sustained journey of personal and professional development. Through peer challenge, deep reflection, and embodied experience, participants develop what most leadership training never touches: the capacity to lead not just from what they know, but from who they've become and what you want to create.
